target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, disposable VirtIO disk clones
result: pass: absent and out-of-bounds-root fixtures were rejected without modifying output variables; a legacy formatted fixture returned LBA 130911 and 128 sectors

layout_followup.result: pass: the source-derived stock absolute-offset/root fixture and the bootstrap relative fixture both return the expected geometry; absent and out-of-bounds-root fixtures are rejected
layout_followup.note: The earlier present fixture represented the bootstrap relative layout only. Pinned RedSeaFormat stores the drive offset and an absolute root sector; the follow-up tests both layouts.

limits: This checks a legacy RedSea boot header, limited geometry and root-sector readability. It does not validate the entire filesystem, mount a drive, support block writes, discover arbitrary partitions, or support Pi storage. The test modifies disposable QEMU copies only.
